model_hypothesis.description: An admitted Edgar GA_Edgar_UltraSkill starts one healing tick per second beginning one second after cast through the native Finnegan's Wake duration endpoint inclusive. Each tick selects the currently active living actor, including Edgar, uses Edgar's live MaxHP at callback time and the cast's effective native Burst talent coordinate for the frozen flat-plus-MaxHP heal curves, then caps at missing HP. Ticks cannot revive a recipient; dead Edgar cancels the stream, off-field living Edgar continues, and a later admitted Burst replaces prior ticks. Full-HP overflow, source MaxHP sampling, recipient switching, inclusive endpoint and recast invalidation are tested hypotheses. Reached live healing bonuses use the separate explicit combat.live_healing_modifiers_v1 formula hypothesis. A5+ admission requires base HP, HP percent excluding Edgar's A5, HP flat, static HP, configured MaxHP and runtime MaxHP to agree after one nearest-integer settlement; caller-provided initial MaxHP is already final and is never boosted a second time. A6's allied DEF grant is outside this healing result.

runtime.tick_schedule: one callback each period, starting cast+period and including the duration endpoint; each Ultimate samples 0-3 currently held Keys of Truth at every awakening and uses 10 seconds plus one second per sampled key
runtime.key_of_truth: An admitted own Skill or QTE grants one key at every awakening; at A1+, an admitted QTE by another living actor grants one key to each living Edgar by actor index, including off-field Edgar and another Edgar actor. This avoids double-granting the QTE wearer while permitting another Edgar to receive the A1 grant. Keys cap at three and persist through Burst and field switches under an explicit no-consumption hypothesis. Admission-time grants require living caster and owner; failed admission grants none. Keys gained during Wake extend a later Ultimate only; they do not move an already scheduled endpoint. The observer consumes the resolved admitted ability ID, so future supported PlayerInput ability adapters can use the same boundary. Edgar currently has no supported PlayerInput QTE route: PlayerInput only defines Special/Dodge and Edgar's input adapter remains unsupported.
runtime.key_trace: edgar_key_of_truth_granted records actor/source and actual before/after key count; edgar_key_of_truth_sampled records the actual admission-time key count, zero consumed keys and Wake endpoint. Healing tick count/time exposes the scheduled endpoint.
runtime.heal_formula: exact_base = flat_value + Edgar_live_MaxHP * max_hp_ratio; apply source healing_bonus and current-recipient incoming_healing_bonus multiplicatively once, round the combined exact amount once to nearest integer, then VitalState caps to missing HP
